steps: Search city on Wikipedia and open article for population
Search city on timeanddate and open Weather for temperature
On Booking enter destination, select dates and travelers, search, open a hotel
On Viator search for two activities and open a top result for each
On the restaurant site search location+cuisine, set date and party size, find a table, open a restaurant
Create a new note summarizing city, dates, population, temp, hotel/price, activities, dinner
Compose email to friend with subject and body summarizing the plan, then discard
